sources.title: 苦澀教訓的發明者給 LLM 規模化狂熱者上了一課慘痛的教訓 / The inventor of the bitter lesson has a bitter lesson for LLM scaling enthusiasts

sources.title_en: The inventor of the bitter lesson has a bitter lesson for LLM scaling enthusiasts
sources.title_original: The inventor of the bitter lesson has a bitter lesson for LLM scaling enthusiasts
sources.summary: Turing Award winner Richard Sutton reaffirms that raw compute alone isn't enough for intelligence and that fundamentally new learning methods are needed. Ex-OpenAI researcher Tworek agrees, saying blind transformer scaling "has reward hacked brains of a whole generation of scientists." A growing wave of startups is already betting on exactly this gap. The article The inventor of the bitter lesson has a bitter lesson for LLM scaling enthusiasts appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 圖靈獎得主李察·薩頓（Richard Sutton）重申，僅靠原始運算能力並不足以實現智慧，且需要根本上全新的學習方法。前 OpenAI 研究員特沃雷克（Tworek）表示贊同，並稱盲目的 transformer 規模化「對整世代科學家的頭腦進行了獎勵駭客（reward hacked）。」一股日益增長的創業公司浪潮已經在押注這個差距。

sources.title: 「大腦即電腦」的比喻塑造了現代AI，但可能會誤導關於意識的辯論 / The brain-as-computer metaphor shaped modern AI but may be misleading the consciousness debate

sources.title_en: The brain-as-computer metaphor shaped modern AI but may be misleading the consciousness debate
sources.title_original: The brain-as-computer metaphor shaped modern AI but may be misleading the consciousness debate
sources.summary: Consciousness researchers Anil Seth, Ned Block, and Giulio Tononi argue in a Nature commentary that today's AI systems aren't conscious and won't become so on silicon hardware. They consider the assumption that consciousness depends on computation alone "fatally flawed" and warn against granting rights to AI systems. The article The brain-as-computer metaphor shaped modern AI but may be misleading the consciousness debate appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 意識研究人員安尼爾·塞斯（Anil Seth）、內德·布洛克（Ned Block）和朱利奧·託諾尼（Giulio Tononi）在《自然》雜誌的評論文章中主張，當今的AI系統並不具備意識，且在矽基硬體上也不會變得具有意識。他們認為「意識僅取決於運算」這種假設是「致命缺陷」，並警告不要賦予AI系統權利。

sources.title_original: AI coding agents still need human cleanup on nearly three out of four tasks in a real-world test
sources.summary: Alibaba's new coding-agent benchmark, Co-Design Bench, tests AI agents on real user requests that already tripped them up in practice. Even GPT-6 Astra, the top performer, fully solves only 26.4 percent of tasks. On older benchmarks, the same models score above 99 percent. The article AI coding agents still need human cleanup on nearly three out of four tasks in a real-world test appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 阿里巴巴的 全新的編碼代理基準測試 Co-Design Bench 在真實使用者請求上測試了 AI 代理，這些請求在實務中已經難倒了它們。即使是表現最好的 GPT-6 Astra，也只能完全解決 26.4% 的任務。在較舊的基準測試中，相同的模型得分超過 99%。

sources.summary: Nous Research released Arete-27B, an Apache 2.0 fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B. On Nous’s 803-prompt eval, propaganda answers fell from 22% to 0.9% while Hermes Bench stayed flat at 65.60%. The post Nous Research Releases Arete-27B that Cuts Qwen3.8-27B Propaganda From 22% to 0.9% appeared first on MarkTechPost .

sources.title_original: Nous Research Releases Arete-27B that Cuts Qwen3.8-27B Propaganda From 22% to 0.9%
sources.summary: Nous Research released Arete-27B, an Apache 2.0 fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B. On Nous’s 803-prompt eval, propaganda answers fell from 22% to 0.9% while Hermes Bench stayed flat at 65.60%. The post Nous Research Releases Arete-27B that Cuts Qwen3.8-27B Propaganda From 22% to 0.9% appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Nous Research 發布了 Arete-27B，這是一個 Qwen3.8-27B 的 Apache 2.0 微調版本。在 Nous 的 803 個提示詞評估中，宣傳性回答從 22% 下降至 0.9%，而 Hermes Bench 則持平在 65.60%。

sources.title: 在真實世界的測試中，AI 編碼代理在近四分之三的任務中仍然需要人類進行清理 / AI coding agents still need human cleanup on nearly three out of four tasks in a real-world test
sources.title_zh: 在真實世界的測試中，AI 編碼代理在近四分之三的任務中仍然需要人類進行清理
sources.title_en: AI coding agents still need human cleanup on nearly three out of four tasks in a real-world test
sources.title_original: AI coding agents still need human cleanup on nearly three out of four tasks in a real-world test
sources.summary: Alibaba's new coding-agent benchmark, Co-Design Bench, tests AI agents on real user requests that already tripped them up in practice. Even GPT-6 Astra, the top performer, fully solves only 26.4 percent of tasks. On older benchmarks, the same models score above 99 percent. The article AI coding agents still need human cleanup on nearly three out of four tasks in a real-world test appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 阿里巴巴的 全新的編碼代理基準測試 Co-Design Bench 在真實使用者請求上測試了 AI 代理，這些請求在實務中已經難倒了它們。即使是表現最好的 GPT-6 Astra，也只能完全解決 26.4% 的任務。在較舊的基準測試中，相同的模型得分超過 99%。

events.news_summary: Seth等學者於Nature評論稱，AI系統非意識，矽硬體亦不會產生意識，並警告勿賦予AI權利。

sources.title: 「大腦即電腦」的比喻塑造了現代AI，但可能會誤導關於意識的辯論 / The brain-as-computer metaphor shaped modern AI but may be misleading the consciousness debate
sources.title_zh: 「大腦即電腦」的比喻塑造了現代AI，但可能會誤導關於意識的辯論
sources.title_en: The brain-as-computer metaphor shaped modern AI but may be misleading the consciousness debate
sources.title_original: The brain-as-computer metaphor shaped modern AI but may be misleading the consciousness debate
sources.summary: Consciousness researchers Anil Seth, Ned Block, and Giulio Tononi argue in a Nature commentary that today's AI systems aren't conscious and won't become so on silicon hardware. They consider the assumption that consciousness depends on computation alone "fatally flawed" and warn against granting rights to AI systems. The article The brain-as-computer metaphor shaped modern AI but may be misleading the consciousness debate appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 意識研究人員安尼爾·塞斯（Anil Seth）、內德·布洛克（Ned Block）和朱利奧·託諾尼（Giulio Tononi）在《自然》雜誌的評論文章中主張，當今的AI系統並不具備意識，且在矽基硬體上也不會變得具有意識。他們認為「意識僅取決於運算」這種假設是「致命缺陷」，並警告不要賦予AI系統權利。

source_material.title: The brain-as-computer metaphor shaped modern AI but may be misleading the consciousness debate
source_material.summary: Consciousness researchers Anil Seth, Ned Block, and Giulio Tononi argue in a Nature commentary that today's AI systems aren't conscious and won't become so on silicon hardware. sources.title_original: The inventor of the bitter lesson has a bitter lesson for LLM scaling enthusiasts
sources.summary: Turing Award winner Richard Sutton reaffirms that raw compute alone isn't enough for intelligence and that fundamentally new learning methods are needed. Ex-OpenAI researcher Tworek agrees, saying blind transformer scaling "has reward hacked brains of a whole generation of scientists." A growing wave of startups is already betting on exactly this gap. The article The inventor of the bitter lesson has a bitter lesson for LLM scaling enthusiasts appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 圖靈獎得主李察·薩頓（Richard Sutton）重申，僅靠原始運算能力並不足以實現智慧，且需要根本上全新的學習方法。前 OpenAI 研究員特沃雷克（Tworek）表示贊同，並稱盲目的 transformer 規模化「對整世代科學家的頭腦進行了獎勵駭客（reward hacked）。」一股日益增長的創業公司浪潮已經在押注這個差距。
